source: SBP EasyData API <https://easydata.sbp.org.pk/api/v1/series/<series_key>/{meta,data}>, dataset 'Inflation Snapshot (New Base: 2015-16)' (TS_GP_PT_CPI_M), original data Pakistan Bureau of Statistics, series TS_GP_PT_CPI_M.P00011516 to TS_GP_PT_CPI_M.P00601516 (60)
notes: SBP EasyData API, Inflation Snapshot (New Base: 2015-16), original data from the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics. 60 monthly series (15 measures x 4 bases), one row per series per month (long format; index_group, region, component and measure_base identify the series). Re-queryable, but SBP may revise or remove data without notice, so each run's raw responses are kept (append_only_snapshot); revisions and status-only changes against the previous run are logged as warnings. Empty values are kept with value null and is_missing true; leading empty months in 12MMA and trimmed-core series are expected. Series names have leading dots and spaces removed in processed; interim keeps them as returned. published_at = 10th of the month after observation_date 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi in UTC, floored at 2019-09-10 23:59:59 PKT (basis conservative_10th_next_month_rebase_2019_09). Months before 2019-08 were back-calculated at the 2019 rebase (is_back_calculated). Older bases (2007-08 and earlier) are not included.
